## New formula library entry

**File:** `library/<id>.json`

### Checklist
- [ ] Filename matches the `id` field (lowercase, hyphens only)
- [ ] Schema validates (`bun run test library`)
- [ ] Thumbnail renders well at seed=1 (visually distinct from other entries)
- [ ] Description is one sentence, plain English
- [ ] Tags use existing kebab-case where possible
